title.en: National Library Board (Fees and Charges) Regulations 2019

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the National Library Board (Fees and Charges) Regulations 2019 and come into operation on 31 January 2019.
2. The fees and charges specified in the second column of the Schedule are payable to the Board in respect of the matters specified opposite in the first column.

6.Membership of library for individuals who —

(a)are not citizens of Singapore;
(b)are not permanent residents of Singapore; and
(c)are not —
(i)below 21 years of age; and
(ii)students of a specified school
7.Late return of library material (other than audiovisual library material) after expiry of loan period
$0.15 per day or part of a day
8.Late return of audiovisual library material after expiry of loan period
$0.50 per day or part of a day
9.Loss or damage of library material
$7.28 per item lost or damaged (in addition to any replacement costs of the library material)
10.Loss of casing of audiovisual library material
$1.07 per casing
11.Reservation of library material
$1.58 per item
